verdict.rationale: NVIDIA's own CUDA documentation describes a full toolchain for building and deploying GPU-accelerated data-center applications, including architecture-specific tuning, compilers/PTX and profiling. The DGX B200 guide ships the NVIDIA Container Toolkit and nvidia-smi for the B200 GPUs. A community thread on B200 GEMM, distributed-training and inference benchmarks indirectly suggests compute workloads run on it. However, no cited CUDA document explicitly lists B200 or Blackwell as a supported compute target, so the story's specific claim is only implied. Missing for 10: explicit CUDA docs naming B200/Blackwell (compute capability) as a supported target, minimum CUDA/driver version for B200, hands-on reports of building CUDA code for B200.
